title: Leni Robredo reiterates stand: ‘No national bid in 2028’

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo on Monday, Nov. 9, pointed out that the decision not to return to national politics came even before she ran and eventually won as local chief executive of the city that her late husband had led for almost 20 years. She said this in a local radio interview as she reiterated that nothing would change her decision not to seek the presidency in the 2028 elections a few days since she was asked to decide by January next year to give herself enough time to prepare for the campaign.
